attributes.check1: Melee or Fortitude or Divine or Diplomacy 20
attributes.name: Lady of Valor
attributes.powers:
Before you act, characters may recharge any number of boons that have the Iomedae trait. For each card recharged, add 1d20 to your check to defeat.

The difficulty of the check to defeat is increased by 10 times the number of characters.

If undefeated, each character is dealt 1d10 Force damage that may not be reduced.

After the encounter, advance the blessings deck, then shuffle Lady of Valor into it.
